title: Bound common-plane helper growth with productive endpoints
body:
## Result

On exact #7481 at `89eaa9d8cae37c1540de98f2d29a3abaabb96a2b` with the retained signed #7113 caller, grant any eligible productive-public helper component growth by a common two-dimensional binary plane, with every productive gap kept positive and all affected paid and productive ranks charged. Among the saved 1,014-plane population, two exact methods exclude all 256 tested ranked cases. The reverse inventory has 552 eligible groups, 2,565 paid edges and 193 productive target edges. All 4,608 shared-price vertex optimizations give upper saving zero. The remaining 758 saved planes and 42,421 outside the saved population were untested. **NO VERIFIED GAIN.**

## Replay

From a clean POSIX checkout with CPython 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-endpoint-common-plane-growth-bound/replay.py
```

Forward closure and independent reverse inventory with direct edge-cut capacities agree on the entire ranking and each tested price bound. The independent controls cover equal paid frames, both signs of the endpoint price and forbidden zero productive ranks. Both methods authenticate the exact source word. The registered replay, exact bytes and modes, official Git-free export and all 27 onboarding tests passed locally. The branch includes the two existing #7257 CI prerequisites.

## Attribution

#7458 supplied the saved plane population, #7456 the productive endpoint model and shared price enclosure, #7454 the reverse lifetime and direct-cut routines, #7362 the directed tariff, and #7481/#7113 the exact source and caller. #7480 and #7334 supply the native construction lineage. #7465 is a related mixed rechart closure proof under dimension-linear prices. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted proof, implementation, independent replay and packaging. Review and merge are left to maintainers.
